interpretation.baseline: Observed delayed snapshot execution prices and sampled depth; zero additional explicit fee and zero extra tick penalty. Does not establish all future platform fees.
interpretation.stress: 10 basis points on each fill and/or one adverse extra tick; explicit assumptions, not inferred Cup fees.
interpretation.fixed: Same latency, depth fraction, order quantity, risk limits, warmup, FIFO and outage/censor rules in each scenario.
interpretation.caution: Independent overlapping flat-wallet probes, not a portfolio, actual ML signals, held-out model performance or independent trades. Scenario admission and fills can differ near limits. Full quantities and censored outcomes retained. No sum of correlated outcomes is claimed as portfolio PnL.
interpretation.source: Derived normalized accepted market decisions; cannot independently verify original private journal or source filtering. Original frozen bank source bindings unchanged.
